lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 15-20 high-luminance circular blobs arranged in three distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, forming a semi-rectilinear grid pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of diffuse higher luminance intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating distinct high-intensity nodes at the points of intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear ridge feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition between the top-lit surface and the shadowed region beneath.

other_distinctive_markers: Intense optical caustics from surface water refraction create a high-contrast, net-like overlay of light across the upper dorsal area, partially masking the underlying skin pattern.
